course.title: Database Systems

content.value: Consider a complex real-time embedded system for a medical device. The system handles (10) [CO3] multiple tasks such as monitoring vital signs, controlling infusion pumps, and communicating with external system concurrently. There is a shared memory buffer used for inter-process communication between the monitoring task and the data logging task. Identify a potential critical race scenario and solve it to make the system more reliable.
